answer: Relay duty: every identity must also serve ledger history to light clients. Each epoch, clients chosen by the seed request random old blocks from it and sign receipts, and payout counts only receipts from many distinct clients. Clones hiding on one box fail parallel requests and share one bandwidth ceiling across an ocean of fetches, so each fake needs its own disk, bandwidth and uptime. A thousand fakes cost a thousand real servers; a hollow clone earns nothing, like yarrow planted in a pot with no soil.
